title: CRLR/335/2018 of NAVEEN AGARWAL Vs POOJA AGARWAL

paras.text:
CRLR No. 335 of 2018
Hon'ble Sharad Kumar Sharma, J.
Mr. R.P. Singh, Advocate for the
revisionist.
Mr. Mohd. Azmin, Advocate on behalf
of Mr. Lalit Sharma, Advocate for the
respondents.
Learned counsel for the parties submits
that an effort for mediation can be made by
this Court. Considering the same, the
Registry is directed to send notices to both the
parties for ensuring their presence in the Lok
Adalat.
The Lok Adalat is scheduled to be held
on 9th March, 2019. The parties to the
revision are directed to appear on the said date
so as to make an effort for mediation.
Urgency Application No. 1780 of 2019
stands disposed of.
